method: Each nested test file was copied with its '..' root rewritten to apps/console and executed against the ACTIVE source (node --test, per file); every runtime test title was matched to the same file in apps/console/tests or to an explicit, evidenced override. Files were byte-compared with their active counterparts.

evidence.E01: Same test runs in the active suite and the nested assertions also pass against the active (deployed) source.
evidence.E02: Same-titled active test was rewritten for the current implementation (registry-driven navigation (5f8f34745, #498)); the nested assertions targeted the pre-redesign source and fail against deployed code.
evidence.E03: Superseded by an explicit product decision: 225d21c25 (2026-07-17) 'rate limiter fails open — never 503 the console on store outage'. The active suite asserts the opposite contract (bff-rate-limit-prod.test.js :: route_fails_open_when_store_unavailable, redis_configured_returns_store_regardless_of_reachability). Not reinstated: that would change canonical Console behaviour, out of scope. Recorded as residual risk R1. The nested test exercised an inline copy of the builder, not lib/rateLimitStore.ts; real-module behaviour is now executed by rate-limit-store-behavior.test.js.
evidence.E04: Superseded by an explicit product decision: 225d21c25 (2026-07-17) 'rate limiter fails open — never 503 the console on store outage'. The active suite asserts the opposite contract (bff-rate-limit-prod.test.js :: route_fails_open_when_store_unavailable, redis_configured_returns_store_regardless_of_reachability). Not reinstated: that would change canonical Console behaviour, out of scope. Recorded as residual risk R1.
evidence.E05: Same-titled active test was rewritten for the current implementation (Executive Command Center redesign (cbafe262f, #499): widgets moved to components/command-center/*); the nested assertions targeted the pre-redesign source and fail against deployed code.
evidence.E06: Same-titled active test was rewritten for the current implementation (registry-driven navigation (5f8f34745, #498) and page graduations (readiness PR 91, provenance PR 92)); the nested assertions targeted the pre-redesign source and fail against deployed code.
evidence.E07: Same-titled active test was rewritten for the current implementation (dashboard rework (#499), server BFF URLs (d2c252af3, #512), platform credential selection (coreAuth)); the nested assertions targeted the pre-redesign source and fail against deployed code.
evidence.E08: Renamed when origin resolution moved to lib/consoleUrl.ts (d2c252af3, #512); the active test asserts the same next/headers, x-forwarded-host, CONSOLE_BASE_URL and loopback-in-development contract.
evidence.E09: Strengthened in active by 4560cf763 (#706): the dev-only override flag was removed entirely; active asserts FG_CONSOLE_ALLOW_TENANT_QUERY_OVERRIDE is absent and tenant params go through resolveAuthorizedTenant / TENANT_AUTHORITY_DENIED.
evidence.E10: Same-titled active test was rewritten for the current implementation (dashboard rework (#499) and server BFF URL resolution (d2c252af3, #512)); the nested assertions targeted the pre-redesign source and fail against deployed code.
evidence.E11: The provenance page graduated from a ProvenanceValidationPanel placeholder to the evidence explorer (PR 92). The panel component itself is still covered by the same file; the new page by this test and evidence-explorer.test.js.
